evidence.claim: The one neocloud-scale operator with an investment-grade balance sheet: $25B of BBB-tier notes at 5.855% in June, backed by Starlink cash flow rather than GPUs, and a reported $40B Apollo-led package (about $10B loans, $30B IG debt) to buy Nvidia chips, closing in 2027. The CFO expects no further equity after the $85.7B IPO.
evidence.numbers: Q2 AI infrastructure revenue $2.2B against $1.9B of depreciation; capex guided at about $18B a quarter; a 10 GW build is roughly $480B at $60B per GW.
evidence.source: SpaceX Q2 2026 release and call; FT via InvestingLive (6 Oct 2026)

evidence.claim: Meta's non-cancelable commitments, mostly third-party cloud capacity plus servers, network and energy service agreements, jumped again. Hyperscaler take-or-pay contracts are what neocloud lenders rely on.
evidence.numbers: $454.52bn at 30 Sep 2026 vs $349.31bn at 30 Jun and $131.05bn at YE25; due in 2027 $121.41bn (was $81.65bn).

evidence.claim: Meta keeps a contingent obligation to buy up to $14.72bn of cloud capacity over five years. The amount falls if the provider resells the capacity, which is a buyer backstop for a neocloud build. Matching it to Nebius's $15bn resale commitment (Mar 2026) is our inference.
Unsecured notes trade near 80 cents (about 15% yield) and five-year CDS hit about 1,128–1,195 bps, implying roughly 45–60% odds of default within five years.
Firmus pulled a near-$5B IPO and AirTrunk delayed its REIT listing to 2027.
Closed a $1B loan at 6.78% fixed, rated Baa1, against contracts with two investment-grade customers, and is raising up to $4B of equity.
SemiAnalysis says neocloud power contracting stalled from Q3 2025 as credit tightened.

question: Can neoclouds keep raising money below what their assets earn?
summary: October repriced weak-credit compute: CoreWeave's unsecured bonds yield about 15% and its default swaps hit records, data center IPOs were pulled, and lenders now price by tenant. Secured loans against strong customers remain open; unbacked parent money has become expensive.
title: Neocloud funding access
